property_summary: Calling onERC721Received on contract C must always return the ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received selector (0x150b7a02), but the buggy version returns 0xFFFFFFFF instead, violating the interface specification.
change_summary: Change the return value from ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector to a different bytes4 constant like 0xFFFFFFFF.
